intent: Sign-up for a web app. A visitor enters an email on the Sign up screen and we send a magic link; 'Verified?' is whether they clicked it within 15 minutes. 'yes' goes to a 3-step Onboarding (name, workspace name, invite teammates — all skippable). 'no' shows a Resend link screen with a 60-second cooldown, max 3 resends, then a support email. 'skip' lets them browse as a guest with read-only access; a guest can finish sign-up later from a banner. No passwords anywhere; Google sign-in is a later addition, not v1.

mustAsk: what 'Verified?' checks (magic link vs code vs password)
what 'skip' / browsing as a guest allows, and whether a guest can convert later
what happens after Resend link (limits, cooldown, failure)
